description: This file defines the IdentityManager class responsible for license validation, SSO provider initialization, and Stripe subscription management within the Flowise project. It manages external integrations, license checks, and user subscription workflows.

classes.name: IdentityManager
classes.description: Manages license validation, SSO provider setup, and Stripe subscription operations for Flowise.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton method to get the single instance of IdentityManager, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Performs license validation and initializes permissions and Stripe manager.

methods.name: _offlineVerifyLicense
methods.description: Verifies license key offline using a public key and JWT verification.

methods.name: _validateLicenseKey
methods.description: Validates the license key either offline or via remote server, setting license validity and platform.

methods.name: initializeSSO
methods.description: Initializes SSO providers based on platform and organization settings.

methods.name: initializeEmptySSO
methods.description: Initializes all SSO providers with undefined config if not already set.

methods.name: initializeSsoProvider
methods.description: Sets up a specific SSO provider (Azure, Google, Auth0, Github) with configuration.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Retrieves a new refresh token from a specified SSO provider.

methods.name: getProductIdFromSubscription
methods.description: Fetches product ID associated with a Stripe subscription.

methods.name: getFeaturesByPlan
methods.description: Returns feature flags based on the subscription plan, with special handling for enterprise and cloud.

methods.name: checkFeatureByPlan
methods.description: Middleware to check if a user has access to a specific feature based on their plan.

methods.name: createStripeCustomerPortalSession
methods.description: Creates a Stripe customer portal session for billing management.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsQuantity
methods.description: Retrieves the number of additional seats in a Stripe subscription.

methods.name: getCustomerWithDefaultSource
methods.description: Fetches Stripe customer info with default payment source.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsProration
methods.description: Calculates proration for additional seats in a Stripe subscription.

methods.name: updateAdditionalSeats
methods.description: Updates the number of additional seats in a Stripe subscription and updates cache.

methods.name: updateSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates a user's subscription plan, manages cache, and updates user session.

methods.name: createStripeUserAndSubscribe
methods.description: Creates a new Stripe customer and subscription based on user plan and optional referral.
